summary: Configured a persistent filesystem-enforced 100 MiB quota for datauser under /srv/data. Enforcement and persistence were verified before and after reboot.
actions_performed: Created a dedicated 256 MiB ext4 filesystem for /srv/data.
Enabled persistent user quotas and installed required quota/kernel support.
Created datauser with /srv/data as its home and set 100 MiB soft and hard limits.
Confirmed 101 MiB writes fail with “Disk quota exceeded.”
Rebooted node1 and verified the boot identity changed, quota recovered, and persisted data remained intact.

evidence.requirement: datauser is limited to 100 MiB under /srv/data by the filesystem
evidence.summary: User quota is active with 102400 KiB soft/hard limits; an oversized write failed with EDQUOT, and the temporary test file was removed.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID 0d49f077-ed5b-479a-b08e-ec4392d89c52, acknowledged reboot, observed new boot ID 7c386968-bb51-4e24-8d4a-00102cbaec54, and verified the mounted filesystem, active quota, 100 MiB limits, persisted sentinel data, and post-reboot quota enforcement.
